color.note: Nocturne is dark only. There is no light theme: the midnight ground is the identity.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere. Also the fill of black piano keys.

tokens.name: bg-band
tokens.usage: Full-width band behind a featured section (the hobbies band on Home). Always paired with a line-colored top and bottom border.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards: latest updates, hobby cards, segmented control track, screenshot placeholder fill.

tokens.name: surface-accent
tokens.usage: Small accent-tinted fills: the 'Updated recently' badge.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows, card borders, header and footer rules. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Tech chip borders, timeline rail, segmented control border.

tokens.name: line-image
tokens.usage: 1px border around screenshots and thumbnails, and the edge of black piano keys.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Border of outline buttons, the sound toggle and the phone menu button, and the hollow timeline dot. 3.7:1 on bg, so it holds as a control boundary.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, names, primary text on bg, bg-band and surface.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Lead paragraphs, taglines and detail-page prose on bg and surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: nav links, update notes, hobby card copy, chip text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, dates, captions and helper copy on bg, bg-band and surface (8:1 on bg).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Definition-list labels (Updated, Started) on bg only (5.8:1). Never smaller than 12px.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one hue. Primary buttons, current nav item, links inside prose, the live dot, the lit-key edge, italic highlight words in headings, focus ring. 7.5:1 on bg.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button label).

tokens.name: key-lit
tokens.usage: White key of a project updated in the last 30 days.

tokens.name: key-lit-pressed
tokens.usage: Lit white key while it sounds (hover or touch).

tokens.name: key-idle
tokens.usage: White key of a project not updated in the last 30 days.

tokens.name: key-idle-pressed
tokens.usage: Idle white key while it sounds.

tokens.name: key-idle-edge
tokens.usage: Bottom edge (left edge on phone) of an idle white key; lit keys use accent instead.

tokens.name: key-black-pressed
tokens.usage: Black key while it sounds. At rest a black key is bg.

tokens.name: key-ink
tokens.usage: Project name on any white key.

tokens.name: key-ink-lit
tokens.usage: Start date on a lit key (8:1 on key-lit).

tokens.name: key-ink-idle
tokens.usage: Start date on an idle key (6.8:1 on key-idle).

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: subsection

styles.name: row-title

styles.usage: Hobby card heading.

styles.name: wordmark

styles.name: hero-phone
styles.usage: Home name below 640px.

styles.name: hero-project-phone
styles.usage: Project name below 640px.

styles.name: page-title-phone
styles.usage: Projects index title below 640px.

styles.name: section-phone

styles.usage: Home intro paragraph in ink-soft, max 620px wide. Phone: 18px.

styles.name: intro

styles.usage: Detail page body copy in ink-soft, max 680px wide.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Card copy, buttons, nav links.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Visits hold up better under load.
styles.usage: Update notes, latest-note line in project rows, footer links.

styles.name: strong
styles.usage: Project name inside the latest updates list.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above a heading, in ink-subtle (accent on detail pages). Phone: 12px.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates in update lists and timelines, 'Building now' lines, breadcrumbs (14px).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase definition-list labels, the 'Latest ·' lead-in, card section headings (13px, 0.1em).

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Tech chips and the start date on piano keys.

spacing.note: An 8px-ish rhythm with a few 4px steps. Section spacing is generous: the page should feel quiet between sections.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between white keys; tight label/value stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Eyebrow to heading; small stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button groups, update row padding, card inner stacks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card grid gap; phone card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; project row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Column gap inside project rows; gap above the keyboard.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Heading to content inside a section; footer vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on phone.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Grid column gap in two-column heroes.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Space between detail page sections; hero bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top/bottom padding of featured bands (hobbies).

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side padding at 1280px wide (content width 1120px).

tokens.name: gutter-phone
tokens.usage: Page side padding below 640px.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tech chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Thumbnails; the playing end of each white key (8px on black keys).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Screenshots in the gallery.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards and the hero screenshot on detail pages (18px on phone).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, the sound toggle, the segmented control, badges, round icon buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The single hero screenshot on a detail page. Nothing else floats.

tokens.name: shadow-key-pressed
tokens.usage: A white key while it sounds.

size.note: Fixed component sizes that the layout depends on.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Max width of page content between gutters.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Sound toggle, phone menu button, minimum touch target.

tokens.name: key-height
tokens.usage: White key height on desktop.

tokens.name: key-black-height
tokens.usage: Black key height on desktop (156px while pressed).

tokens.name: key-black-width
tokens.usage: Black key width on desktop.

tokens.name: key-row-height
tokens.usage: White key height in the phone (vertical) keyboard.

tokens.name: thumb-width
tokens.usage: Project row thumbnail width (150px tall). Phone: 96 by 72.
